title: Observations and Remedies for Large Language Model Bias in Self-Consuming Performative Loop

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the fraction of generated news continuations classified as right-leaning versus left-leaning using a pretrained classifier on prompts from a politically polarized news dataset (Webis-Bias-Flipper-18).
Computing the model's average preference probability for non-creative (knowledge-aware) attributes versus creative writing attributes using the Preference Dissection benchmark.
Measuring the disparity in Pass@1 accuracy between easy math problems (Chinese K-12 exams) and hard math problems (international math olympiads) using the NuminaMath dataset.
